name: mg4rq5-account-computers
goal: A signed-in iPhone discovers the account’s computers without a QR scan. Explicit Mac project grants remain required. QR remains a collapsed fallback.

evidence: After Google sign-in the root phone gate directly prompts for the camera. The account should identify eligible computers. The scan remains available in a collapsed recovery path and local project grants remain controlled by the Mac.

The existing unpaired Capacitor case starts at the camera prompt. Strengthen its initial checkpoint to prove the scanner is hidden until the person explicitly opens the alternative, then keep the same scan and computer-approval assertions.
